narrative.details: In the Blasted Lands, there is a troubled spirit who was once a great hero of the horde.  A warrior's honor does not die with the body, and it would serve you well to speak with him.
narrative.objectives: Speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the entrance to the Blasted Lands.
narrative.offerRewardText: So, you have come to alleviate my pain. I wish you could simply strike me down, but it is not that simple...
narrative.requestItemsText: Did Stoley cough up my booze?

giverName: Torm Ragetotem / Sorek / Christoph Walker / Kelv Sternhammer / Wu Shen / Darnath Bladesinger
